title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian and Moroccan flavors, this lamb tagine is a hearty and aromatic dish that combines the warmth of North African spices with the richness of Italian ingredients.
instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
2. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the lamb shoulder and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the canned tomatoes, dried apricots, raisins, Moroccan spice blend, and salt.
6. Stir to combine, then add the water.
7. Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
8. Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
9. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve hot.
